test_fbnet_v2_classification: test FBNetV2 classification models like fbnet_a, fbnet_b, fbnet_c with pretrained weights
test_fbnet_v2_backbone: test FBNetV2 backbone models for feature extraction without the classification head
test_fbnet_backbone_stage_indices: test FBNetV2 backbone with selected stage indices to get intermediate feature maps
test_fbnet_custom_arch: test a custom FBNet architecture defined via a blocks dictionary with num_classes
test_fbnet_flops: test and print FLOPs for FBNetV2 models using flops_utils.print_model_flops
